title: PS5 gaming cafe setup cost in India (2026)
description: A 6-PS5 gaming cafe costs about ₹14.8 lakh to set up and ₹87,000 a month to run. Full breakdown, profit at 45% occupancy and how it compares to a PC cafe.

body.text: A console-only gaming cafe is cheaper to start than a PC cafe and simpler to run. Here is what a 6-PS5 cafe costs in a tier 2 city, using typical Indian prices from October 2026 in the Hash [gaming cafe cost calculator](/gaming-cafe-cost-calculator).

items: 6 PS5 Slim consoles with 43-inch 4K TVs and an extra controller each: ₹6 lakh
Interiors and wiring for about 450 sq ft: ₹5.4 lakh

body.text: At ₹70 an hour, 14 hours a day and 45% occupancy, six consoles bring in about ₹1.19 lakh a month, leaving roughly ₹32,000 profit and a break-even of about 47 months. Console stations often host two players at once, so many cafes charge per controller or per player, which can raise revenue a lot.

Consoles cost less per station, use less power and need less upkeep, and they are great for EA FC, Tekken and party games with friends. PCs earn more from competitive players. Most successful cafes run a mix; see [PS5 vs gaming PC for a gaming cafe](/blog/ps5-vs-gaming-pc-for-gaming-cafe-india) for the full comparison.

List your cafe on Hash so gamers nearby can book your PS5s in advance, and host [EA FC](/tournaments/ea-fc) and [Tekken](/tournaments/tekken) tournaments to fill quiet hours. Try your own numbers in the [gaming cafe cost calculator](/gaming-cafe-cost-calculator).
